title: Saturn Would Float in a Giant Bathtub
description: Saturn is the only planet in our solar system less dense than water.

scenes.text: If you could find a bathtub big enough, Saturn would float in it.
scenes.subject: saturn
scenes.say: [curious] If you could find a bathtub big enough... Saturn would FLOAT in it.

scenes.text: Saturn is enormous. More than seven hundred Earths could fit inside it. But it is mostly hydrogen and helium gas.
scenes.subject: saturn
scenes.say: [excited] Saturn is enormous. More than seven hundred Earths could fit inside it. But it is mostly hydrogen and helium gas.

scenes.text: That makes it the only planet in our solar system that is less dense than water, on average.
scenes.say: That makes it the only planet in our solar system that is less dense than water, on average.

scenes.text: Of course, no such bathtub exists, and the planet would not stay in one piece. But on paper, it floats.
scenes.say: [laughs] Of course, no such bathtub exists, and the planet would not stay in one piece. But on paper, it floats.

scenes.text: A giant that weighs less than it looks. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: saturn
scenes.say: A giant that weighs less than it looks. [chuckles] Follow for more weird facts.
